§6Shield System§f

§aBuild customizable forcefields that block, damage, or camouflage, your base's invisible wall.§f

The §bShield Projector§f (tiers 1-4) creates energy barriers from shield template blocks. §e200,000 RF§f buffer, §e5,000 RF/t§f input. Tier 1 supports up to §e256 blocks§f of shield.

§6Modes§f:
§b• Pass/Block§f: Filter by Players, Hostiles, Passives, or All Entities
§b• Camouflage§f: Mimic any solid block texture, or go invisible
§b• Damage§f: Deal §e5.0 damage§f per hit, costs §e1,000 RF§f per mob, §e2,000 RF§f per player

§6Running Costs§f (per 10 active blocks):
§b• Base§f: §e8 RF/t§f
§b• Shield mode§f: §e+2 RF/t§f
§b• Camo mode§f: §e+2 RF/t§f

Killing mobs with shield damage grants §bLooting III§f and §e2 Dimensional Shards§f per kill.

§9Note:§f Use shield templates to define the shape, then the projector replaces them with energy blocks.
